objective: Preregister 24 candidates (12 POLITICAL + 12 PLACEBO_BIGTECH) -- rotation_cell's unedited cross-sectional momentum rotation mechanism -- applied to the political/congressional-trade-replica ETF menu (NANC, GOP, MAGA, DEMZ) and a non-political big-tech placebo menu (QQQ, XLK, SPY, DIA), grid = lookback {63,126,252} x top_n {1,2} x rebalance {monthly,weekly} per menu, judged on select+anchor windows only (stress window not computed -- NANC/GOP have zero coverage). No backtest is run in this round.

windows.stress_not_computed_reason: NANC/GOP launched 2023-02-07, zero coverage of 2016-05-02..2023-09-15; per the runbook's short-sample rule, judged on select+anchor only, tier capped at watch_recent.

keep_rule.K1_select_anchor_only: date-neutral Sharpe (median over rebalance offsets) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral anchor Sharpe (>=1.19) in BOTH the select and anchor windows, 10bp per side, positive CAGR at 20bp both windows. Because the stress window is not computed, K1 alone caps at watch_recent, never a full keep (matches the runbook: 'stress period pending' candidates cannot clear K1 fully).
keep_rule.K2: 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in both select and anchor windows -- also reference-only pending stress coverage, same watch_recent cap.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window date-neutral Sharpe >= 1.19 (select window also computed and reported) -- forward-tracked only, not a keep, explicitly labeled stress-pending.
keep_rule.placebo_dominance_disqualifier: For any POLITICAL candidate reaching watch_recent or better: if the same-grid-cell (same L, N, freq) PLACEBO_BIGTECH candidate's anchor-window judged Sharpe is >= the POLITICAL candidate's, downgrade to 'not_kept (reproducible by plain big-tech momentum)' regardless of the K1/K2 numeric result. Fixed before any return is computed.
keep_rule.wide_spread_sensitivity: For any POLITICAL candidate reaching watch_recent or better (and surviving the placebo-dominance check): recompute anchor-window annualized return and Sharpe at 40bp per side; require positive annualized return. Computed separately by scripts/analyze_h20260928_43_wide_spread.py.
keep_rule.pass_requires: K1 OR K2 (both capped at watch_recent for POLITICAL given stress-pending status) AND not disqualified by placebo dominance AND positive at 40bp
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: 24 candidates; report all regardless of outcome; DSR with n_trials=24 for any that pass.
keep_rule.g3_placebo: not applicable in the frozen-gate sense (no discretionary pick or gate-timing parameter fit locally); the PLACEBO_BIGTECH menu itself serves as this batch's placebo/disqualifier test, per the queue task's extra requirement.
